description: Shipped source files that read the process environment outside the permanent process boundaries allow-listed, file by file, in scripts/gates/process-env.mjs (KRN-10). Each entry is one file; its variables move to a plugin env declaration or the resolved environment, and the entry is removed with that change.

entries.reason: Serve reads NODE_ENV directly; KRN-12 hands it the resolved environment name with the roles a process runs (KRN-11a hands the commands the resolved environment, but serve.ts is assembled by the application, which KRN-12 owns).
defineModel resolves the column encrypter from process.env; DAT-10 makes encryption a column codec whose plugin owns the keyring and declares the keys in its env.
The jobs runtime config reads queue variables from process.env; KRN-12 deletes the module in favour of the jobs plugin and its declared env.

server-components: reads its signing keys and mode from process.env; KRN-14 leaves it a plain kernel plugin (its component metadata moves onto the AppManifest), which declares them in its env and reads the mode from its setup context.
The proxy diagnostic reads NODE_ENV directly; KRN-12 hands the server the resolved environment name when it assembles the process.

useValkeyConnections falls back to VALKEY_URL from the process environment for its consumers still on the legacy contract (broadcast, jobs, live), which declare no variables; it goes when they convert and pass their declared env.
auth: reads its variables from process.env; SEC-12 converts the plugin onto definePlugin (its tables onto schema contributions) and declares them in its env.

jamal's verbs default their environment (host user, failure report) to process.env; KRN-11b's defineJamal loader hands them the resolved environment.
